[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone trooper commander]] [[Keller (clone commander)|Keller]] led a '''unit''' of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] on the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Toola/Legends|Toola]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], near the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the war, the unit took part in an [[Battle of Toola|assault]] on the Confederacy's main [[Power generator/Legends|generators]] on Toola, under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Simms]] , [[Kai Hudorra]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Noirah Na]]. During the assault; however, the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] commenced when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, declared that [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was in effect, turning the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] against their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. The unit [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Simms, and hunted down the two remaining Jedi to no avail.

==History==
{{Quote|Commander Keller, one of the STAPs is out of fuel. They ditched them and set off on foot. They're heading towards Ithaqua Station.''"<br />"''Comm ahead. Alert the Garrison at the station.|One of Keller's troopers informs him of the Jedi's location|<ref name="ITU" />}}
At the onset of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Keller's unit was sent to the frigid planet of Toola to combat CIS forces stationed there. After weeks of stalemate against the Separatist forces, Jedi General Kai Hudorra, Jedi General Simms, and Hudorra's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] launched an assault on the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids']] main generators with a small portion of the unit while the rest of the clones staged a diversionary attack.<ref name="ITU" />

Their ploy was successful, but shortly after, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Keller received orders to execute Order 66, and the clones started firing upon their Jedi leaders. The clones were successful in killing Jedi Master Simms, but Kai Hudorra and his padawan fled on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]].<ref name="ITU" />

[[File:Keller_raid.png|thumb|left|125px|Keller and his men raiding Ithaqua Station.]]
Shortly after, Keller and his unit tracked down the two Jedi to [[Ithaqua Station]], a small civilian port on the planet. Once they reached the station, Keller and his men started searching for the two missing Jedi, raiding as many places as they could and asking people for their identification papers. After reaching a small bar where Hudorra was drinking, Keller and two of his men started searching for the Jedi. To their dismay, the patrons of the bar started attacking them, as Kai had managed to convince them to turn on the clones.<ref name="ITU" />

Keller's unit kept searching Ithaqua Station, but never found the two Jedi as they managed to get away on a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="ITU" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Kellers_Unit_Trooper.png|thumb|right|100px|A trooper in Keller's unit]]
Troopers in Keller's unit utilized white Galactic Marine armor<ref name="SW30C" /> and standard [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|phase II clone trooper armor]]. Some troopers in the unit also had yellow markings on their shoulders. They were also equipped with [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]] and [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbines. During their time on Toola, some members of the unit rode [[Mastmot/Legends|Mastmots]] equipped with two [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] mounted on their sides.<ref name="ITU" />
